changes.decision: identity-first/fail-closed; do not promote as network-wide tariff candidate
positiveEvidence: Current Enercom public site exposes electricity/gas retail market-index information, including PUN, but this is retail-energy pricing and not an EV public-charging tariff.
negativeEvidence: No current first-party public EV charging tariff/grid was found in this pass.
No deterministic current PUN partyId/EVSE mapping was established from the historical label alone.
prohibitedInference: Do not use Enercom retail PUN/energy-supply prices as EV charging prices.
Do not attach an anonymous current PUN partyId to Enercom by name similarity alone.
Do not repeat generic Enercom tariff web search without new EVSE/partyId evidence.
changes.resumeCondition: Obtain a current EVSE/address or PUN/OCPI partyId tied to Enercom, then inspect that station's direct QR/app/payment surface; alternatively accept a new first-party EV charging tariff publication with explicit scope.

next: Continue unreconciled current PUN partyIds by EVSE count, testing network/class-wide tariff evidence first; defer station-level identity-only cases and keep Atlante last.
